headline: THE 11:00 TOUR AT 355 COMANCHE HAS RUN AND THE READ IS NOT BACK — that is normal ninety minutes on, not a flag, but it was the only event on your entire calendar and it decides whether the price cut bought real traffic or one curious agent. Chase it this afternoon rather than waiting on the form. 🆕 THE OTHER THING THAT MOVED: the 195 Lake View REPAIR ADDENDUM landed at 7:31 this morning with two documents on dotloop — the inspection wait is over and the response clock is now yours. ⏸️ Otherwise not one ShowingTime event in twenty-nine hours across every listing you have. ⚠️ YOUR FORWARD CALENDAR IS NOW COMPLETELY EMPTY.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE TOUR HAS NOW HAPPENED. The price moved from $299,000 to $295,000 on Tuesday's notice and that same notice carried a booking for 11:00 this morning — the first fresh appointment this listing had taken since three separate buyers said the number was wrong. ⭐ It ran on schedule. ⏳ NO READ HAS COME BACK IN THE NINETY MINUTES SINCE, which is early rather than late — most forms land the same evening.
hotSignals.action: Chase this one by phone this afternoon instead of waiting on the written form. It is the single most informative read you will get this week: it tells you whether the cut bought real traffic or one curious agent, and there is nothing else on the calendar to learn from. ⛔ Quote $295,000 only — no read on this listing has ever named a replacement number.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE BUYER'S AGENT ASKED FOR A COUNTER — OUT LOUD, TWICE — AND IT IS NOW TWO DAYS OLD. Jay G. left a second voicemail asking what number your sellers want back, and named his buyer's ceiling himself while doing it. ⭐ That is offer intent stated without being asked for, on a house his buyer has already walked twice. ⚠️ It is a POSITION, not a receipt — nothing is on paper. ⏰ Your listing agreement on this house expires 2026-08-14, eight days out, and the counter under discussion proposes an Aug 31 contingency deadline — seventeen days past your authority to represent these sellers.
hotSignals.action: Get a number back to him TODAY, and get the agreement extension signed in the same conversation with your sellers — those are one call, not two. ⚠️ You cannot quote a counter your sellers have not approved, so the seller call comes first. ⚠️ NOTHING OUTBOUND TO EITHER PARTY APPEARS IN EMAIL OR THE TEXT RELAY THIS MORNING — stated as absence, not failure, since a phone call leaves no trace here. Silence on a second ask is how a buyer bidding against himself talks himself back down. ✅ Exactly one chip exists for this — updated in place, no twin.

hotSignals.signal: Mallory W. · ARC Realty Vestavia filed interested YES · priced JUST RIGHT · "Client loves the space and the fact that it has room for washer and dryer" — and phoned three minutes earlier to say her client "really, really liked it" and "wants to put an offer in" but needs to save a little more for the down payment, asking to be told if any other offer arrives. ⭐ STILL THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ON THE BOARD, now five days old. ✅ She returned your call Tuesday evening with a self-declared twenty-five-minute window, so the relationship is live and she has put in writing exactly what her buyer needs help with.
hotSignals.action: Call her — the phone is the ONLY channel: machine outreach to buyer's agents is suspended by your own Monday ruling until the send-safety ledgers are restored, and they are still genuinely missing from this machine and from Drive. The question is what specifically gets her buyer to the table: timing, possession, or help at closing. ⚠️ You have not yet asked your seller for a number, so you would go into that call with nothing to trade. Ask him first — that single question is the whole unblocker. She asked to be warned about competition, which means she intends to compete.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE BUYER SIDE CALLED TO ASK ABOUT COMPETING OFFERS. An assistant to the agent who showed it Monday evening asked that night whether any offers are in or expected. ⭐ Agents do not ask that about houses their buyers are lukewarm on. ⭐ The sellers' own doorbell camera corroborates it — the mother was heard saying she loved it repeatedly. ⚠️ STILL UNANSWERED on day five, and it is still the only live buyer thread on a listing taking a tour a day.
hotSignals.action: Answer it today, honestly, in either direction. "No offers yet" is a perfectly good answer and it forces a decision; silence just lets them drift to the next house.

upcoming: ✅ RAN THIS MORNING — Thu 8/6 11:00 AM — 355 COMANCHE STREET, Montevallo. 🔥 THE FIRST BOOKING SINCE THE PRICE CAME DOWN, confirmed on the same notice that carried the new number. $295,000 · ACTIVE re-verified on that notice. ⏳ No feedback returned in the ninety minutes since — early, not late. ⭐ Chase it by phone this afternoon; it is the only thing on the board capable of teaching you anything this week.

Seven tours in eight days across five brokerages on a house that took exactly one showing in its first eleven days — and three consecutive buyers have rejected it for the same reason. They like the house and reject its SHAPE. ⭐ NOBODY HAS TOUCHED THE PRICE: every price and price-recommendation field on all three reads came back blank. ⭐ THAT MAKES THIS A MARKETING PROBLEM, NOT A PRICING ONE — if the photography and copy promise a bigger, more open house than the floor plan delivers, that mismatch is what is burning six clear-outs a week on owner-occupants. Re-shooting the wide angles and naming the layout honestly costs a fraction of a price cut. 🔥 The Monday competing-offer question is unanswered on day five and is still the only live buyer thread here. ⭐ It is also your best lead source on the board — four of today's eight call-block names came off this one ad.
